'''2024 Supreme Southern Showdown''' was a Players Committee major event in Atlanta, Georgia, 12–14 January 2024. [[Jeff Lavigne]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-01-supreme-southern-showdown-atlanta-georgia-jan-12-14/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Dates:''' 12–14 January 2024
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1420146#p1420146 forum]
